title: Earthquake, Indonesia, 21 November 2022 (EQ20221121IDN)
description:
UNOSAT geodata for Earthquake, Indonesia, 21 November 2022 (EQ20221121IDN), from 3 datasets on the Humanitarian Data Exchange. HDX describes the event:

**UNOSAT code EQ20221121IDN, GDACS Id: 1347183**  This map illustrates potentially damaged structures and damaged structures in Cianjur district, Jawa Barat Province, Indonesia as detected by a Pléiades image acquired on 23 November 2022 at 10:00 local time. Within the analyzed area, UNOSAT has identified 111 potentially damaged structures, 8 damaged structures and 10 temporary shelters.
This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).

HDX datasets:

- [Damage Assessment in Cianjur district, Jawa Barat Province, Indonesia  as of 23 November 2022](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-cianjur-district-jawa-barat-province-indonesia-as-of-23-november-2022)
- [Damage Assessment in Cianjur district, Jawa Barat Province, Indonesia  as of 29 November 2022](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-cianjur-district-jawa-barat-province-indonesia-as-of-29-november-2022)
- [West Java Earthquake (21 November 2022, M 5.6) - UNOSAT Live Web Map](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/west-java-earthquake-21-november-2022-m-5-6-unosat-live-web-map)
